_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Uganda covering Bunyoro-Kitara, Buganda Kingdom, Speke/Baker source of the Nile, British protectorate, Obote, Idi Amin, Bush War, Museveni/NRM, LRA/Joseph Kony, and oil discovery.

910.name: Early Peoples and Iron Age
910.description: Hunter-gatherer communities; Bantu and Nilotic migrations; development of iron-working and agricultural societies in the Great Lakes region.

sub_clusters.name: Early Hunter-Gatherer Communities
sub_clusters.description: Batwa and other hunter-gatherer communities; Stone Age sites in western Uganda; forest-dwelling peoples.

sub_clusters.name: Bantu and Nilotic Migrations
sub_clusters.description: Bantu-speaking peoples arrive from west; Nilotic (Luo, Acholi, Langi) and Nilo-Hamitic peoples from the north; iron smelting traditions.

920.name: Great Lakes Kingdoms
920.description: Rise of Bunyoro-Kitara empire; emergence of Buganda, Ankole, Toro, and Busoga kingdoms; cattle and banana-based civilisations.

sub_clusters.name: Bunyoro-Kitara Empire
sub_clusters.description: Bunyoro-Kitara as dominant Great Lakes kingdom; Bachwezi dynasty legends; control of salt, iron, and cattle.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of Buganda Kingdom
sub_clusters.description: Buganda emerges as tributary of Bunyoro; gradually expands; kabaka (king) centralised power; maritime control of Lake Victoria.

sub_clusters.name: Ankole and Toro Kingdoms
sub_clusters.description: Ankole (Nkore) and Toro kingdoms; Hima-Iru social stratification; pastoral aristocracies.

930.name: Buganda Expansion and European Exploration
930.description: Buganda becomes dominant power; Arab trade contacts; Speke and Baker seek source of the Nile; religious wars.

sub_clusters.name: Buganda Dominance
sub_clusters.description: Buganda supplants Bunyoro as regional power; standing army; sophisticated administrative system; Arab trade in guns and cloth.

sub_clusters.name: Speke and Baker: Source of the Nile
sub_clusters.description: John Hanning Speke reaches Lake Victoria 1858; identifies source of the Nile; Samuel Baker discovers Lake Albert.

sub_clusters.name: Religious Wars in Buganda
sub_clusters.description: Catholic, Protestant, and Muslim factions battle for influence; Uganda Martyrs 1885-1887; Kabaka Mwanga's resistance.

940.name: British Protectorate
940.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Uganda Agreement 1900; Buganda privileged position; cotton and coffee economy; path to independence.

sub_clusters.name: IBEAC and Early British Control
sub_clusters.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Lugard arrives 1890; British protectorate declared 1894.

sub_clusters.name: Uganda Agreement 1900
sub_clusters.description: Agreement between Britain and Buganda; mailo land system; Buganda chiefs become landed gentry; indirect rule.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Economy
sub_clusters.description: Cotton and coffee cash crops; Asian commercial class; railway extension; north-south development divide.

sub_clusters.name: Buganda Crisis and Path to Independence
sub_clusters.description: Kabaka Mutesa II exiled 1953; returns 1955; Buganda federalism question dominates; independence 9 October 1962.

950.name: Post-Independence Turmoil
950.description: Obote's centralisation; Idi Amin's reign of terror; Tanzanian invasion; second Obote regime; Bush War; Museveni victory.

sub_clusters.name: Obote First Government
sub_clusters.description: Milton Obote PM then president; abolishes kingdoms 1967; 'Move to the Left'; Buganda crisis; increasing authoritarianism.

sub_clusters.name: Idi Amin's Reign of Terror
sub_clusters.description: Idi Amin seizes power; expulsion of 80,000 Asians 1972; State Research Bureau; estimated 100,000-500,000 killed; Entebbe raid 1976.

sub_clusters.name: Tanzania War and Amin's Fall
sub_clusters.description: Amin invades Kagera strip; Tanzania counterattacks and captures Kampala April 1979; Amin flees.

sub_clusters.name: Bush War and NRM Victory
sub_clusters.description: Museveni's NRA/NRM wages guerrilla war from Luwero Triangle; captures Kampala January 1986; 'fundamental change'.

960.name: Museveni Era and Modern Uganda
960.description: NRM governance; economic recovery; HIV/AIDS response; LRA insurgency; oil discovery; multiparty transition; democratic backsliding.

sub_clusters.name: NRM Economic Reconstruction
sub_clusters.description: Museveni stabilises economy; 'no-party' Movement system; structural adjustment; praised as 'new breed' African leader.

sub_clusters.name: HIV/AIDS Response
sub_clusters.description: Uganda's early and effective HIV/AIDS response; prevalence drops from 15% to 5%; ABC campaign; global model.

sub_clusters.name: LRA Insurgency and Joseph Kony
sub_clusters.description: Lord's Resistance Army under Joseph Kony terrorises northern Uganda; child abduction; ICC warrants; Kony 2012 campaign.

sub_clusters.name: Oil Discovery in Albertine Graben
sub_clusters.description: Commercial oil discovered in Lake Albert region; pipeline to Tanzania planned; resource curse concerns; environmental issues.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Regression
sub_clusters.description: Term limits removed 2005; age limit removed 2017; Bobi Wine opposition; disputed 2021 elections; authoritarian consolidation.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
